notes: Optical output power and many receiver/transmitter metrics are specified per ZR400/ZR300/ZR200/ZR100 profile. Power dissipation stated as < 22 W. Reach 80–120 km without EDFA/DCM; up to 500 km with EDFA. Duplex LC UPC interface. Center wavelength accuracy +/- 0.02 nm (nominal center wavelength not given). Transmitter OSNR (Inband) stated as > 34 dB/0.1nm. OSNR penalty tolerance 0.5 dB listed without paired penalized OSNR value and Rx power condition. Power budget 23 dB in ordering description. Output power stability +/- 0.5 dB; output power accuracy +/- 2 dB. Transceiver start up time < 120 s; channel tuning speed < 60 s. Storage temperature -40 to +85 °C (not normal operating range).
